howto.what: 安装后 Claude 会获得一份《The Web Handbook》文档,包含入门指南、API 用法、故障排查、更新日志等4个部分;能引用其中的代码示例、表格和文件路径来回答问题。
howto.when: 当你说要测试多文件 HTML 构建,或需要查阅该文档的入门、API、故障排查、更新日志等内容时触发。

say.text: 这份《The Web Handbook》的入门指南讲了什么?
say.note: Claude 会引用文档第 1 部分内容回答

say.text: 给我看 API 用法的代码示例
say.note: Claude 会提供文档中的 Python 示例

say.text: 帮我查故障排查和更新日志
say.note: Claude 会整理并说明这两部分要点

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude gains access to a document called "The Web Handbook" with 4 sections: Getting Started Guide, API Usage, Troubleshooting, and Changelog. It can reference code examples, tables, and file paths found in that documentation when answering questions.
howto.when_en: This skill triggers when you ask to test the multi-file HTML build, or when you need to look up the handbook's getting started, API usage, troubleshooting, or changelog content.

say_en.text: What does the Getting Started Guide in this handbook say?
say_en.note: Claude will answer using content from section 1

say_en.text: Show me the code examples for API usage
say_en.note: Claude will provide Python examples from the docs

say_en.text: Help me look up troubleshooting and the changelog
say_en.note: Claude will summarize those two sections
